what: Arm designs the processor architecture used in almost every smartphone and a growing share of cars, PCs and data-centre chips. It does not make chips: it licenses designs and collects a royalty on each chip sold.
customers: Chip designers such as Apple, Qualcomm, Nvidia, Samsung, MediaTek and the cloud giants.
money: a fee on each Arm-based chip shipped
upfront fees for access to its designs
moat: An ecosystem of software and engineers built around its architecture over decades, which makes switching very hard.
risks: Customers moving to the open RISC-V standard
